assumptions.statement: research/integrated-finalists/status.json is authoritative for finalist eligibility.
assumptions.consequence: Every non-baseline integrated action fails closed; component entrypoints remain evidence-only.

assumptions.statement: The 60 research/runs/v03-*.json records and retained C00 proof directories are authoritative baseline evidence.
assumptions.consequence: Reproduction writes fresh proofs only below excluded research/reproduction/.work and never rewrites authoritative records.

assumptions.statement: The frozen C00 native prover's recorded operating-system entropy source and immediate native/codec checks are the executable hiding-proof witness.
assumptions.consequence: The prove action rejects missing, repeated, retained, unverified, or differently sourced proof metadata.

assumptions.statement: Foundry's local embedded EVM is the only permitted EVM execution route in this package.
assumptions.consequence: verify-evm accepts only client=anvil and exposes no RPC URL, key, broadcast, deploy, or live-chain option.

assumptions.statement: New files under manifest roots may be added by concurrent evidence work.
assumptions.consequence: Manifest verification checks every pinned listed file and permits additions; regeneration is required to pin additions.

nullPolicy: Unknown and unmeasured values remain absent or explicit NOT_EVALUATED; they are never converted to numeric zero.
